scope.summary: Implement garment skin-weight binding export (CG-28, MD EveryWear core / 2025.2 skin-weight transfer; GREQ-019 + MOAT-7 partial): transfer body skeleton skinning weights to a draped garment mesh for non-simulated wear in engines, with per-garment-class projection profiles (tight/dress/skirt), rigidity-mask respect for hardware, and emission through glTF and FBX-bridge skeletal lanes.
acceptance_criteria: transfer_skin_weights(garment, avatar_skeleton, profile) projects per-vertex weights from the avatar body (nearest-surface + smoothing iterations) onto the draped garment; influence cap + renormalization per target (GREQ-004 coordination).
Garment-class profiles bias projection (skirt profile avoids leg-split weights - the classic autofit failure); trim/hardware vertices under rigidity masks bind rigidly to the dominant bone.
Skinned garment exports as skeletal mesh in glTF (skins) and via the FBX Blender-bridge; a UE-import smoke fixture proves the garment follows a test animation without simulation.

MT-476 delivers the authoritative core weight-transfer consumed by MT-446, which completes the masking-brush UI, template rigging, LOD, texture-bake, live-preview, and engine-delivery behavior in this same WP; neither MT may satisfy its capability rows with a placeholder or future deferral.
scope.risk_if_missed: Game characters wear skinned clothing, not simulated cloth, for 90% of garments; without weight transfer every Tailor garment is render-only and the game lane (operator's stated later target) is blocked.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; GUI exposure rides the existing Tailor panels and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Publishing and DCC interchange

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.

Use authenticated SurrealDB record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; administrative/root credentials and UI filtering are never the security boundary. PostgreSQL and SQLite access paths are forbidden.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
